Look up Martin Seligman, and his research on learned helplessness. Basically, I think one of the keys to successfully meeting goals in life is recognizing that you are in control of, and responsible for your actions. When a person feels that society, a bad situation, circumstances which can be temporary are removing actionability from their life, uncertainty prevails, and a sense of powerlessness, and depression ensue.
